summary: Sharplink, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a registered direct offering of 10,013,351 common shares at $7.49 per share, raising ~$75 million gross, plus warrants exercisable at $8.15 for four years. The shelf takedown (Form S-3ASR) has no acquisition or structural-change catalyst; net proceeds are for purchasing Ether, working capital, and share repurchases. A.G.P. served as placement agent at 2% fee. No negotiation, premium, or strategic pivot beyond capital raise and treasury management is present. This is a routine capital-markets transaction, not a special situation.
